description: Update an existing memory by writing a superseding record (or consolidating into an existing record) and a durable revision entry (prior/new content hashes, timestamp, reason). (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

content.description: New content for the superseding record (or existing target content when consolidating)

id.description: Memory UUID or numeric record_id to update

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the revision entry

superseded_by_id.description: Optional existing memory UUID or numeric record_id that supersedes this record

name: memory.update
title: Update Memory
